item.title: 【HD Live Performances】WEB-RiP - Sigrid - Belladrum Festival, UK, 27-07-2023
item.description:
Reupload. Thanks to AlexTheKid who sent the video to me. I added an extra audio track with higher (normalized) volume because the original volume is too quiet + a file with the setlist. This is a great show: one great pop banger after another. Highly recommended.
